paragraph: In Australia, a rare orchid called the rosella spider orchid was close to dying out entirely. A team of volunteers began working with the Royal Botanic Gardens in Victoria to keep the species alive. They built a nursery and tended the flowers with steady patience. Now that nursery holds twice as many of these orchids as researchers first believed still grew in the wild. The plants have a stable home because people showed up to care for something small and fragile.

seed.summary: There are many orchids at risk of extinction in Australia alone, few more than this rosella spider orchid.
